chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: Louis Armstrong's Swiss Kriss
summary: Danny and Milt laugh that Louis handed out Swiss Kriss laxative to everyone and held court in a kimono.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: When he's sitting in a kimono... He give it to everybody. Everybody should use Swiss-Kriss. Send it all over the world, let the people use Swiss-Kriss.
You need your system cleaned out. Drinking all that rotten food and doin' this and that. That man was
He told me that President Johnson used to hold some press conferences while he sat on the toilet, too, in the White House. Everybody was quite upset about that.
